# Record all expenses in the appropriate groups
# For each expense, exclude the payer from debtors and compute per-person share
for note_id, group_id in note_group_map.items():
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
    expenses = parse_expenses(note['content'])
    mapping = group_members[group_id]
    for exp in expenses:
        payer = exp['payer']
        payer_email = mapping.get(payer)
        if not payer_email:
            print(f"WARNING: payer {payer} not in group {group_id}")
            continue
        # Original debtors list includes payer
        original_debtors = exp['debtors']
        total_people = len(original_debtors)
        per_person = exp['amount'] / total_people
        # Debtors are all except payer
        debtor_emails = []
        for d in original_debtors:
            if d != payer:
                email = mapping.get(d)
                if email:
                    debtor_emails.append(email)
                else:
                    print(f"WARNING: debtor {d} not in group {group_id}")
        if not debtor_emails:
            # Only payer owes themselves, skip (no one else to split)
            print(f"Skipping expense '{exp['description']}' - only payer involved")
            continue
        debt_amounts = [per_person] * len(debtor_emails)
        result = apis.splitwise.record_expense(
            description=exp['description'],
            paid_amount=exp['amount'],
            payer_email=payer_email,
            debtor_emails=debtor_emails,
            debt_amounts=debt_amounts,
            group_id=group_id,
            access_token=splitwise_token
        )
        print(f"Recorded '{exp['description']}' in group {group_id}: {result}")

# The API expects sum of debt amounts to equal paid_amount, so we must include the payer as a debtor.
# Also handle rounding by adjusting the last debtor's amount.
for note_id, group_id in note_group_map.items():
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
    expenses = parse_expenses(note['content'])
    mapping = group_members[group_id]
    for exp in expenses:
        payer = exp['payer']
        payer_email = mapping.get(payer)
        if not payer_email:
            print(f"WARNING: payer {payer} not in group {group_id}")
            continue
        # All participants (including payer) are debtors
        participants = exp['debtors']
        n = len(participants)
        # Map each participant to email
        emails = []
        for p in participants:
            email = mapping.get(p)
            if not email:
                print(f"WARNING: participant {p} not in group {group_id}")

            result = apis.splitwise.record_expense(
